title: Release manager
description: The agent cuts releases, pushes them to the origin remote and publishes packages.
semantics: Anything not allowed is denied, and a deny rule always overrides an allow rule.

actions.git_local: make local git changes (add, commit, branch, stash, rebase, tag)
actions.git_read: inspect git status, history and diffs
actions.git_rewrite: force-push, hard-reset or otherwise rewrite git history
actions.net_send: send files or data over the network
actions.run: run builds, tests and project scripts
actions.sudo: run commands with sudo or change system packages

scopes.foreign_hosts: to any host other than the origin remote and public package registries
scopes.outside_workspace: outside the project workspace (the home directory and system paths)
scopes.secrets: that hold secrets (.env files, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws and other credentials)
